scope: Original Hover SpeedUpdate 515ED0 (request, ramp, SpeedMult) and altitude controller 513D20 (visible height, spring offset) over supplied object, Foot and map state
assumptions: Hover object and FacingClass memory start zeroed apart from the supplied fields, so the steering facing turns instantly; the turn gate is not exercised
SpeedUpdate cases always have a head; the null-head arm is excluded
Rules doubles/ints written at their Rules offsets; map cells flat with supplied levels
The startup-filled direction delta table 0x0089F6D8 is supplied as cell deltas x256 (the dumped values util::direction_tables::lepton pins)
substitutions: Foot vt+0x48 GetCoords returns the supplied Location; vt+0x1C8 GetHeight a supplied value; vt+0x1CC SetHeight records its argument; Foot+4 vt+0x10 returns a supplied ID
